questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got into all the courses I wanted, but I had to change courses as some overlapped.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer:
It is easy to change your courses if some of them overlap.
You can check the schedule of courses from previous years, often the time stays the same --> good orientation.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Dairy Technology was one of the best courses of my Masters. Practicals at the pilot plant, small class size (there were only 8 of us), field trip to the dairy industry, great teachers.
